newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds ended somewhat firmer in line with German Bund futures and U.S. bonds.
Most business was in Conf futures with the rest of the market barely active. "The market just doesn't have any power," one trader said.
Two-year swaps gave up one basis point to 2.03/13 percent. Five and ten-year swaps were down two points each to 2.84/94 percent and 3.74/84 percent, respectively.
Conf futures up 25 points to 120.50 percent.
Euro Swiss francs up two points at 98.40.
